page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. It is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for boot volumes and data persistence. It features no GPU accelerators, relying entirely on the host CPU for all processing tasks. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

Due to its dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.s2.large provides predictable compute performance without the CPU credit limitations or sharing overhead found in burstable instances. With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, it represents a cost-efficient option for lightweight compute-bound workloads, basic web serving, small utility applications, and development environments that require dedicated CPU execution but have modest memory requirements.
